caption:
Can someone explain why every 'basic' plan has a price that keeps creeping up? 😩
Streaming, phone, internet, gym. Each one goes up a few dollars and says 'thanks for being a loyal customer.'
It's never one big jump. It's twelve small ones.
Which bill crept up on you the most?
first_comment: Name the one bill you'd cancel today if you could. 👇
